items.content: A vulnerability marked as critical has been reported in Netty up to 4.1.135/4.2.15. This affects an unknown function of the component STOMP Encoder. The manipulation leads to injection. This vulnerability is uniquely identified as CVE-2026-59920. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. No exploit exists. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component.

items.title: CVE-2026-54705 | arnog MathLive up to 0.109.x Text Mode Escaping atom-to-math-ml.ts cross site scripting
items.author: vuldb.com
items.content: A vulnerability labeled as problematic has been found in arnog MathLive up to 0.109.x. The impacted element is the function Box.toMarkup/xmlEscape/scanText/convertLatexToMarkup/convertLatexToMathMl/MathfieldElement.createHTML of the file src/core/box.ts/src/formats/atom-to-math-ml.ts of the component Text Mode Escaping. Executing a manipulation can lead to cross site scripting. This vulnerability is handled as CVE-2026-54705. The attack can be executed remotely. There is not any exploit available. The affected component should be upgraded.

items.title: CVE-2026-8497 | Devolutions Password Manager up to 2026.2.1 Connection certificate validation
items.author: vuldb.com
items.content: A vulnerability identified as problematic has been detected in Devolutions Password Manager up to 2026.2.1. The affected element is an unknown function of the component Connection Handler. Performing a manipulation results in improper certificate validation. This vulnerability is known as CVE-2026-8497. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. No exploit is available. You should upgrade the affected component.
